5911.description: Number of ticks between day low (for buy order) or day high (for sell order) and limit price

Indicates whether this message is the last in a sequence of messages for those messages that support fragmentation.

5920.name: ExclusiveFlag

5921.name: ExternalMarkUp

5924.description: This field will contain the offer dollar price for discount-quoted securities.

5925.name: IndexRatio
5925.description: This field is the Index Ratio.

5931.description: Minimum anytime fill quantity on an order, for subsequent fills. Works alongside tag 110 as MinQty (which effectively acts as minimum initial quantity).

5932.name: MinLeavesQty
5932.description: Minimum order quantity to be left on an order. Potential fills which take LeavesQty (tag 151) below this value will not be executed.

5933.name: GeneralLedgerAccount
5933.description: This is the General Legder Account field.

5934.name: ClearingRefNo

5943.name: MaxDeltaNeutrality
5943.description: The percentage change in long position minus the percentage change in short position has to be less than this value.

5944.name: InitialDisplayQty
5944.description: Initial display quantity of a reserve order that can be returned in an ExecutionReport in addition to the currently displayed quantity contained in 1138 DisplayQty. It is intended as an echo of the input.

5945.name: TargetVolumeReference

5946.name: PendingReason
5946.description:

Replace, Pending Cancel) being returned (String).

5949.name: BinID

5954.name: TradingPortfolioNetDeltaMax
5954.description: for portfolio strategies, this field would indicate the max delta in dollar terms for the overall portfolio

5955.name: SchedulingDays

5956.name: DarkBlockLimitPrice

5968.name: CalculatedAllocQty2
5968.description: Amount of allocation in contra currency on far leg of a swap.

5973.description: Citi-FX custom ExecType to support orders for FX ECommerce.

5976.name: NoUserData

5989.name: AllinPriceFlag

Indicates trading method for security.
